derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G639 (ἀπορέω);
def: to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond

occurrences.text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
